context: Two teens compare a new comedy show after class
purpose: Teach: 判ら/ヘルプ/あいまい/ステキ/ジョーク/ボリューム/終始/輝く

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、昨日の新しいコメディ番組見た？主役の子、出てきた瞬間から目が輝くタイプで、もう終始笑ってたんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, did you watch that new comedy show yesterday? The lead's eyes literally sparkle from the moment they appear, and I was laughing the whole way through.
lines.style: Excited high-school girl gushing about a show after class, casual rising tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た！でも正直、最初の方は話があいまいでさ、何が起きてんのか全然わかんなかったんだよな。
lines.en: Yeah I saw it! But honestly, the beginning was kind of vague, and I really couldn't tell what was even going on.
lines.style: Laid-back teen boy being honestly critical but friendly, slightly drawling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる〜。でもさ、ラストの夕焼けのシーンめっちゃステキじゃなかった？あそこで一気にやられたわ。
lines.en: Totally get it. But you know, that sunset scene at the end was so lovely, right? That's where I got completely won over.
lines.style: Bubbly teen girl shifting to heartfelt admiration, sing-song delivery with a sigh.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、あそこは確かに良かった。中盤のジョークのテンポも結構好きだったし。
lines.en: Ah, yeah, that part really was good. I kinda liked the joke pacing in the middle too.
lines.style: Teen boy conceding a point with measured agreement, slightly grumbling tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ただBGMのボリュームがデカすぎて、セリフが半分くらい聞き取れなかったんだよ。
lines.en: The thing is, the BGM volume was way too loud, so I missed like half the dialogue.
lines.style: Teen boy giving honest technical complaint, mild irritation creeping in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー、それな。配信アプリのヘルプに字幕の出し方載ってるから、それオンにして見直すといいよ。
lines.en: Ah, true that. The streaming app's help section explains how to turn on subtitles, so try rewatching with those on.
lines.style: Helpful teen girl sharing a practical tip, friendly informative pitch.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで？そりゃ助かるわ。設定どこにあるか判らなくてずっと放置してたんだよな。
lines.en: Seriously? That really helps. I had no idea where the settings were so I'd just left it alone.
lines.style: Teen boy reacting with genuine relief and a sheepish admission, casual drawl.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ね、来週も主演ふたりの掛け合い続いたら絶対バズるって。私もう完全にファンだもん。
lines.en: Right? If the chemistry between those two leads keeps up next week, it's definitely gonna go viral. I'm totally a fan already.
lines.style: Teen girl wrapping up with confident prediction and personal declaration, upbeat.
